EARTH._note: Mission variable name (mission_scoring.json) -> real column in output_real/earth_real_1deg.csv. Identity entries are listed so every mission variable is accounted for.

slope_300m_deg.true_baseline_km: central difference over 2 DEM pixels: 3.706 km N-S, 3.706*cos(lat) km E-W (DEM pixel 1.853 km, ETOPO 2022 60 arc-second)
slope_300m_deg.caveat: no open global DEM-derived product at a 300 m baseline is used here; slopes at a ~3.7 km baseline are systematically LOWER than 300 m slopes, so the mission's 300 m thresholds (0.5-15 deg) are not directly comparable. slope_p90_deg is a stricter alternative. Poleward of ~85 deg use slope_iso_deg (3.706 km baseline in both directions), as for the Moon.

rough_300m_m.true_baseline_km: lag of one DEM pixel = 1.853 km in both directions (east pairs taken 1/cos(lat) pixels apart, linear interpolation), same definition as the Moon (1.895 km)
rough_300m_m.caveat: RMS height difference (deviogram) at a ~1.85 km lag, not 300 m; values grow with lag, so they are larger than a 300 m roughness would be. The mission thresholds (5-650 m) were written for 300 m.

elevation_m.caveat: area-weighted mean land elevation above the EGM2008 geoid (sea level); empty for cells with no land pixel. The Moon's elevation_m is relative to a 1737.4 km sphere, so the common gate elevation_m >= 1 has no physical meaning there.

mask_fraction.caveat: land share of the cell from ESA CCI LC 2020 (inland water counts as water); the engine's gate >= 0.3 now means '>= 30 % land'

rock_or_bare_frac.caveat: bare (CCI 200-202) + sparse vegetation <15% (CCI 150-153) share of land pixels; a land-cover classification, not rock abundance

temp_k.caveat: annual mean clear-sky LAND SURFACE temperature (mean of day and night MODIS climatologies), not air temperature; empty in Antarctica

lst_diurnal_amp_k.caveat: annual mean ~10:30 minus ~22:30 clear-sky LST; underestimates the true daily amplitude; lst_diurnal_amp_max_k = largest monthly value

tmin_c.caveat: WorldClim 2.1 coldest-month mean daily minimum AIR temperature (1970-2000), interpolated; MODELLED; WorldClim licence is non-commercial, no redistribution without permission

irradiance_kwh_m2_day.caveat: WorldClim 2.1 srad annual mean (interpolated), global horizontal

sun_low_frac_0_5deg.caveat: formula; fraction of daylight time with the Sun 0-5 deg high

thermal_inertia_class.caveat: ASSUMED mapping from ESA CCI land-cover classes (class_mappings.json); MODELLED, not a measured thermal inertia

permafrost_class.caveat: from Obu et al. modelled permafrost probability (MODELLED); empty (no data) south of about 18-25 N except Antarctic outcrops, on ice sheets, and on cells without CCI land

wind_max_ms.caveat: windiest-month MEAN 10 m wind speed (WorldClim 2.1), not a gust or daily maximum

MOON._note: Mission variable name -> real column in output_real/moon_real_1deg.csv. Written by real_data/build_moon.py.

slope_300m_deg.true_baseline_km: central differences over 2 pixels: 3.79 km north-south, 3.79 km x cos(lat) east-west
slope_300m_deg.caveat: Not a 300 m slope. km-baseline slopes are much gentler than rover-scale slopes; a 15 deg gate means something different here. slope_p90_deg is the steeper tail. Poleward of ~85 deg the literal 1-pixel east-west spacing shrinks to metres and inflates slope_deg/slope_p90_deg; slope_iso_deg/slope_iso_p90_deg (3.79 km baseline in both directions) are the reliable values there.

rough_300m_m.caveat: RMS height difference at one LOLA pixel (deviogram), not at 300 m. Values grow with baseline (Hurst exponent ~0.5-0.9), so it is larger than a 300 m roughness.

rock_or_bare_frac.caveat: 1 by definition (no vegetation). Measured rock abundance is rock_abundance_frac (60S-60N).

temp_k.caveat: Diurnal mean surface bolometric brightness temperature, not air temperature.

lst_diurnal_amp_k.caveat: tmax_k - tmin_k of the season-averaged diurnal curve.

irradiance_kwh_m2_day.caveat: Horizontal surface, per 24 h, DERIVED; uses the LOLA topographic illum_frac (Mazarico 2011 simulation) at |lat| >= 65.5.

permafrost_class.caveat: 'ninguno' on every cell: a MODELLED label set by definition (no terrestrial-type permafrost on the Moon), not a measurement.
